title: Make CI secret scanning blocking and complete
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that CI ignores secret-scan failures and Invoke-SecretScan.ps1 caps scanning at 500 files while silently skipping read failures. Evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml line 45 and Scripts/Invoke-SecretScan.ps1 line 122. Make failures blocking after baseline cleanup, remove or explicitly report file caps, and fail on read errors.
